items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the limit preservation of the three functors of surjectivity, vanishing and isomorphism at source lines 1334-1349, label lemma-iso-limits, whose proof occupies source lines 1351-1417. The proof is a three part limit argument of substance: part one reduces to the quasi-compact case by passing to the scheme theoretic support and then localises along a surjective etale morphism from an affine scheme which is itself a directed limit, so that an algebra criterion for surjectivity applies; part two does the same for injectivity while controlling the quasi-compact scheme theoretic support of the source through an affine etale chart; and part three is a nontrivial combination, obtaining surjectivity at some stage, forming the kernel, proving that kernel is of finite type with support inside a quasi-compact one, and applying part two to it. The counted statement records neither the reductions nor the kernel argument.
